    def observe_outcome_free(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        self._load()

            con.execute("INSERT INTO wave_resource_events VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)", ("resource-" + _sha_json({"a": attempt_id, "k": "close"})[:32], proposal_id, logical_id, attempt_id, "ATTEMPT_CLOSED", policy_hash, cumulative, ctx.recorded_at))
            con.execute("COMMIT")
        except BaseException:
            if not con.getautocommit():
                con.execute("ROLLBACK")
            raise
        finally:
            con.close()
        return digest

    def trial_execute(self, proposal_id: str, ctx: DaemonContext) -> dict[str, Any]:
        ctx.validate()
        read = self._open()
        try:
            bindings, _ = self._proposal(read, proposal_id)
            self._authority_applied(read, proposal_id)
        finally:
            read.close()
        kind = self._kind(bindings)
        self._scientific_observations(bindings)
        adapter = PC6ExecutionAdapter(bindings)
        adapter.observe_outcome_free()
        features = adapter.load_features()
        order = None
        candidates_by_id: dict[str, Any] = {}
        if kind == "W1":
            candidate_file = json.loads((self.scientific_root / "P5_P3_H0_DISCOVERY_WAVE1_CANDIDATE_LIST_V2.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            order = json.loads((self.scientific_root / "P5_P3_H0_WAVE1_EVALUATION_ORDER_SUBOBJECT_V1.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            candidates_by_id = {item["candidate_id"]: item for item in candidate_file["candidates"]}
            if len(order) != 174 or set(order) != set(candidates_by_id):
                raise FailClosed("W1_FROZEN_SCOPE_DRIFT")
        frozen, frozen_hash = self._freeze_inputs(features, kind, order)
        # F07: all outcome-free DEVELOPMENT_REJECTED states are computed and the
        # rejected/evaluable set is frozen BEFORE any W1 label access (marker
        # below).  Rules exactly per W1 contract section 6, in frozen order.
        rejection_by_candidate: dict[str, str | None] = {}
        admissible_by_horizon: dict[int, list[int]] = {}
        rejection_set_sha256 = None
        if kind == "W1":
            cohort_rows = features["cohorts"]
            for horizon in (8, 24, 168):
                admissible_by_horizon[horizon] = [
                    index for index, row in enumerate(cohort_rows)
                    if mat.w1_admissible(int(row["decision_us"]), horizon)]
            seen_candidate_hashes: set[str] = set()
            seen_weight_paths: set[str] = set()
            assert order is not None
            for candidate_id in order:
                candidate = candidates_by_id[candidate_id]
                horizon = int(candidate["holding_horizon_hours"])
                admissible = admissible_by_horizon[horizon]
                feature_rows = [cohort_rows[index].get("candidate_features", {}).get(candidate_id, {})
                                for index in admissible]
                frozen_rows = [frozen[candidate_id][index] for index in admissible]
                rejection_by_candidate[candidate_id] = mat.development_rejection_reason(
                    candidate, feature_rows, frozen_rows,
                    seen_candidate_hashes, seen_weight_paths)
            rejection_set_sha256 = _sha_json(rejection_by_candidate)
        logical_id, attempt_id, ordinal, checkpoint_sha = self._reconcile_and_open_attempt(proposal_id, bindings, kind, ctx)
        hold_ms = os.environ.get("P5_TEST_HOLD_AFTER_ATTEMPT_OPEN_MS")
        if hold_ms is not None:
            if os.environ.get("P5_SYNTHETIC_MODE") != "1":
                raise FailClosed("FAULT_INJECTION_FORBIDDEN")
            time.sleep(int(hold_ms) / 1000.0)
        start_ns = _monotonic_ns()
        resume = checkpoint_sha is not None
        start_index = 0
        diagnostics: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        if checkpoint_sha:
            checkpoint_path = self.artifact_root / "checkpoints" / f"{checkpoint_sha}.json"
            checkpoint = evaluator.read_checkpoint(checkpoint_path, checkpoint_sha)
            expected = {"logical_trial_id": logical_id, "binding_sha256": bindings.digest, "candidate_list_sha256": bindings.candidate_list_sha256, "evaluation_order_sha256": bindings.evaluation_order_sha256}
            if any(checkpoint.get(key) != value for key, value in expected.items()):
                raise FailClosed("CHECKPOINT_BINDING_MISMATCH")
            start_index = int(checkpoint.get("completed_prefix", -1))
            diagnostics = checkpoint.get("private_diagnostics", [])
            if start_index < 0 or start_index > 174 or len(diagnostics) != start_index:
                raise FailClosed("CHECKPOINT_PREFIX_INVALID")
        self._mark_label_access(proposal_id, logical_id, attempt_id, kind, bindings, frozen_hash, ctx, resume)
        # F01: outcomes are DERIVED by the TCB-pinned materializer inside the
        # daemon strictly after APPLIED + durable marker; no outcomes file.
        outcomes = adapter.derive_outcomes(marker_recorded=True)
        labels_by_horizon = self._outcome_cohorts(outcomes)
        if len(outcomes.get("cohorts", [])) != len(features["cohorts"]):
            raise FailClosed("PC6_COHORT_ALIGNMENT_MISMATCH")
